Anna (Finance): Heads-up: Clearwave invoice INV-2029-0045 shows a $12,300 spike for Feb — looks like staging API key used in prod. Need to approve manual credit + promo goodwill. Attaching logs.
Raj Patel: Can you confirm it's the staging key? I remember a deploy on Feb 3 that rotated keys.
Anna (Finance): Yep matched by api_key 'staging-clearwave-01' in logs. Attached sample lines:
```2029-02-15T04:12Z POST /v1/generate  1.2M tokens key=staging-clearwave-01```
Leigh (CS): :frowning: customer reached out, says unexpected bill. Requested immediate refund or credit so they don't churn.
Mariya (Billing): If we do manual credit, >$10k needs manager approval per policy. I can draft approval memo. What's proposed? Full refund or partial?
Anna (Finance): Propose: $10k manual credit (goodwill) + $2,300 promo credit applied to next invoice. Keeps ledger clean.
Raj Patel: SRE/infra needs to confirm staging key leak and close the hole. @eng-sre can someone verify no other accounts affected?
BillingBot: Auto-note: Invoice INV-2029-0045 flagged. Created ticket #BILL-6721.
Leigh (CS): Customer ok with that plan if we apply ASAP. Can we expedite? They need confirmation today.
Mariya (Billing): I'll start approval thread. @FinanceManager please approve manual adjustment of $10,000 for Clearwave (INV-2029-0045). I'll attach evidence.
FinanceManager: Approved on principle — please include SRE verification and confirmation email sent to customer. cc: legal if we change terms.
Anna (Finance): Thanks — will apply credit once SRE confirms. Drafting customer note now.
Raj Patel: SRE confirmed: only that one key used, rotated and revoked. No other accounts seen. Logs attached.
Anna (Finance): Credit applied: $10,000 manual adjustment (accounting ref ADJ-4821), $2,300 promo credit scheduled for next invoice. Email sent to customer. Closing thread.
